Mary, mother of Jesus: Mhandara Maria Mutsvene, Amai vaMwari uye Amai veChechi, akasarudzwa kubva narini kuti abereke Muponesi. Akabatwa pamuviri asina chivi uye ari mhandara nguva dzose; akatorwa kudenga nemuviri nemweya.
Our Lady of Guadalupe: Muna 1531 Mhandara Yakaropafadzwa yakaonekera kuna Mutsvene Juan Diego pagomo reTepeyac pedyo neguta reMexico, ikasiya mufananidzo wayo pajasi rake. Ndiye Muchengeti weAmerica.
Our Lady of Fátima: Muna 1917 Mhandara Yakaropafadzwa yakaonekera kuvana vatatu vafudzi kuFatima, Portugal, ikadaidza nyika kuminamato, kutendeuka, Rozari yezuva nezuva uye kuzvipira kuMwoyo wayo Usina Gwapa.
Our Lady of Lourdes: Muna 1858 Mhandara Yakaropafadzwa yakaonekera kuna Mutsvene Bernadette kagumi nesere kuLourdes, France, ikati: "Ndini Akabatwa Pamuviri Asina Chivi." Tsime rayo rava nzvimbo yokuporeswa nokufamba kutsvene kubva ipapo.
Our Lady of Aparecida: Muna 1717 vabati vehove vakabudisa murwizi Paraíba chifananidzo chiduku cheAkabatwa Pamuviri Asina Chivi, mambure avo asina chinhu akazara nehove. Maria weAparecida ndiye Mambokadzi uye Muchengeti weBrazil.
Our Mother of Perpetual Help: Mufananidzo mutsvene wekare unoratidza Mwana Jesu achitizira kuna Amai vake paanoona zvishandiso zveKutambudzika kwake. Akaropafadzwa Pius IX akauisa mumaoko eVaRedemptorist muna 1866 kuti vauzivise pasi rose.
Our Lady of the Pillar: Tsika inoti Mhandara Yakaropafadzwa yakauya kuna Mutsvene Jakobho Muapostora kuZaragoza kuzosimbisa kuparidza kwake muSpain, ikasiya shongwe sechiratidzo. Ndiye Muchengeti weSpain nevanhu vanotaura chiSpanish.
Our Lady of Mount Carmel: Maria saAmai uye Muchengeti weBoka reVaKarmeri. Akapa Mutsvene Simon Stock Skapulari yebrown sechiratidzo chokudzivirira kwake kune vose vanoipfeka nokutenda.
Our Lady of the Rosary: Mutambo uyu unorangarira kukunda kweLepanto muna 1571, kwakawanikwa apo vatendi vainamata Rozari. Unotidaidza kufungisisa zvakavanzika zvaKristu pamwe naAmai vake.
Our Lady of Sorrows: Unokudza kugovana kwaAmai Vakaropafadzwa muKutambudzika kwoMwanakomana wavo kuburikidza nezvironda zvavo zvinomwe, kubva pauprofita hwaSimeoni kusvika pakuvigwa kwaJesu. Vakamira nokutendeka pasi peMuchinjikwa.
Immaculate Conception: Nenyasha dzakakosha dzaMwari, Mhandara Maria Mutsvene akachengetedzwa pachivi chekutanga kubva panguva yokutanga yokubatwa kwake pamuviri. Mutambo wemuchengeti weAmerica.
Assumption of Mary: Pakupera kweupenyu hwake hwepanyika, Mhandara Maria Mutsvene akatorwa nemuviri nemweya mukubwinya kwekudenga, sezvakaziviswa zviri pamutemo naPapa Pius XII muna 1950.
Sacred Heart: Chishanu chinotevera Svondo rechipiri mushure mePendekosti
Kuzvipira kuMwoyo Mutsvene waJesu kunokudza rudo rwake runopisa kuvanhu. Ishe akazarurira Mutsvene Margaret Mary Alacoque zvipikirwa zvawo muma1670.
Holy Family: Jesu, Maria naJosefa mumba mavo muNazareta, muenzaniso kumhuri imwe neimwe yechiKristu mukutenda, murudo uye mukuteerera Mwari.
Trinity: Chakavanzika chikuru chokutenda kwedu: Mwari mumwe muVanhu vatatu vaMwari, Baba, Mwanakomana noMweya Mutsvene.
Holy Spirit in Christianity: Munhu wechitatu woUtatu Hutsvene, Ishe noMupi woupenyu, akaburukira paVaapostora paPendekosti uye anoita Chechi kuti ive tsvene.
Christ the King: Papa Pius XI akagadza mutambo mukuru uyu muna 1925 kuzivisa umambo hwaJesu Kristu pamwoyo wose, mhuri norudzi.
Divine Mercy: Kuzvipira kurudo rwaMwari rune tsitsi rwakazarurirwa Mutsvene Faustina Kowalska, rwakapfupikiswa muminamato "Jesu, ndinovimba nemi." Mutsvene Johane Pauro II akagadza Svondo reTsitsi dzaMwari muna 2000.
Santo Niño de Cebú: Chifananidzo choMwana Jesu Mutsvene chakapiwa parubhabhatidzo rwamambokadzi weCebu muna 1521, chifananidzo chechiKristu chekare kupfuura zvose muPhilippines.
Juan Diego: Mutsvene Juan Diego Cuauhtlatoatzin, mugari wenyika akazvininipisa akatendeuka, akaonekerwa naMai Vedu veGuadalupe muna 1531. Mutsvene Johane Pauro II akamuita mutsvene muna 2002.
Kateri Tekakwitha: "Ruva reLiria reVaMohawk" (1656–1680), mhandara yakatendeuka, yakachena uye yainamata zvikuru, mutsvene wekutanga wevagari venyika kuNorth America.
Martin de Porres: Hama yeVaDominican kuLima, Peru (1579–1639), aizivikanwa nokuchengeta kwake nokuzvininipisa varwere nevarombo vemarudzi ose. Muchengeti wokururamisira munzanga.
Francis Xavier: Mumwe weVaJesuit vokutanga, akaunza Evhangeri kuIndia, kumaodzanyemba nokumabvazuva kweAsia uye kuJapan, akabhabhatidza zviuru zvizhinji. Muchengeti wemamishinari.
Francis de Sales: Bhishopi weGeneva uye Mudzidzisi weChechi (1567–1622), akadzidzisa kuti munhu wose anodaidzwa kuutsvene. Muchengeti wevanyori nevatori venhau.
Saint Joseph: Murume waMhandara Maria Mutsvene uye baba vanorera vaJesu, munhu akarurama akachengeta Mhuri Tsvene. Muchengeti weChechi yose, vanababa, vashandi nerufu rwakanaka.
Saint Patrick: Bhishopi uye Muapostora weIreland muzana ramakore rechishanu. Akaendeswa kuIreland senhapwa achiri mukomana, akadzokazve semishinari akaunza chitsuwa kukutenda.
Anthony of Padua: Mupristi weVaFrancisca uye Mudzidzisi weChechi (1195–1231), muparidzi ane simba uye muiti weminana. Muchengeti wevarombo nezvinhu zvakarasika.
Francis of Assisi: Muvambi weVaFrancisca (1181–1226), akagamuchira urombo kuti atevere Kristu akagamuchira maronda aIshe. Muchengeti weItaly nemhuka.
John the Baptist: Mutungamiri waIshe, akaparidza kutendeuka, akabhabhatidza Jesu muJoridhani uye akapa upenyu hwake semufiri wechokwadi.
Michael (archangel): Muchinda wehondo yekudenga, anodzivirira vanhu vaMwari pamisungo yaSatani. Muchengeti wemasoja, mapurisa nevarwere.
Raphael (archangel): Ngirozi huru yakatungamirira Tobhiya ikaporesa Tobhiti; zita rake rinoreva kuti "Mwari anoporesa." Muchengeti wevafambi nokuporeswa.
Gabriel: Ngirozi huru yakazivisa Mhandara Maria kuti achava Amai voMwanakomana waMwari. Muchengeti wevatumwa nevanozivisa nhau.
Saint Peter: Mukuru weVaapostora uye Papa wekutanga, akapiwa naKristu makiyi oUmambo. Akaurayiwa semufiri kuRoma uye akarara pasi peBasilika yaMutsvene Petro.
Paul the Apostle: Muapostora weVahedheni, akatendeuka munzira inoenda kuDhamasiko. Nzendo dzake netsamba dzake zvakaendesa Evhangeri munyika yose yeVaRoma, uye akaurayiwa semufiri kuRoma.
Saint Anne: Amai vaMhandara Maria Mutsvene uye ambuya vaJesu, vanokudzwa pamwe naMutsvene Joakimu. Muchengeti wanaamai nanaambuya.
Thérèse of Lisieux: Sista weVaKarmeri uye Mudzidzisi weChechi (1873–1897), Ruva Duku, akadzidzisa "nzira duku" yokuvimba norudo. Muchengeti wemamishinari.
Jude the Apostle: Muapostora uye hama yaIshe, akanyora Tsamba yaJudha. Muchengeti wenyaya dzisina tariro.
Vincent de Paul: Mupristi wokuFrance (1581–1660) akavamba Ungano yeMamishoni neVanasikana veRudo. Muchengeti wamabasa ose erudo.
Thomas Aquinas: Mupristi weVaDominican uye Mudzidzisi weChechi (1225–1274), akanyora Summa Theologiae. Muchengeti wezvikoro zveKaturike nevadzidzi.
Rita of Cascia: Mukadzi, amai, chirikadzi uye sista weVaAugustine (1381–1457) akatsungirira matambudziko nemoyo murefu mukuru. Muchengeti wenyaya dzisingagoneke.
Augustine of Hippo: Bhishopi uye Mudzidzisi weChechi (354–430), akatendeuka nokuda kweminamato yamai vake, Mutsvene Monika. Akanyora Kureurura.
Saint Monica: Amai vaMutsvene Augustine, vakawana kutendeuka kwomwanakomana wavo mushure memakore mazhinji eminamato yakatendeka. Muchengeti wanaamai nevakadzi vakaroorwa.
Saint Sebastian: Musoja weRoma akaurayiwa nokuda kokutenda munguva yaDiocletian munenge muna 288. Muchengeti wemasoja nevatambi.
Saint Lawrence: Dhikoni reRoma akaurayiwa semufiri muna 258, akaratidza varombo sepfuma yechokwadi yeChechi. Muchengeti wemadhikoni nevarombo.
Saint Stephen: Mumwe wemadhikoni manomwe okutanga uye mufiri wokutanga weChechi, akafa achinamatira vaimutema nematombo.
Saint Nicholas: Bhishopi weMyra muzana ramakore rechina, aidiwa nokuda kwetsitsi dzake nezvipo zvake zvakavanzika. Muchengeti wevana nevafambisi vezvikepe.
Saint George: Musoja uye mufiri wekutanga kwezana ramakore rechina, muenzaniso woushingi mukutenda. Muchengeti wemasoja nemaScout.
James the Great: Muapostora uye hama yaMutsvene Johane, wokutanga pagumi navaviri kuurayiwa semufiri. Nzvimbo yake tsvene kuSantiago de Compostela inokwezva vafambi veCamino. Muchengeti weSpain.
Andrew the Apostle: Hama yaMutsvene Petro uye Muapostora akatanga kudaidzwa, akaunza Petro kuna Jesu. Akaurayiwa pamuchinjikwa kuPatras. Muchengeti weScotland.
Martin of Tours: Musoja weRoma akagovana jasi rake nemupemhi, akazova Bhishopi weTours (akafa 397). Muchengeti wemasoja.
Benedict of Nursia: Baba voupenyu hwemamonki kuMadokero (munenge 480–547), Mutemo wake weminamato nebasa wakatungamirira mamonki kwemazana emakore. Muchengeti weEurope.
Saint Dominic: Muvambi weBoka reVaparidzi (1170–1221), akazvipira kuparidza chokwadi nekuRozari.
Ignatius of Loyola: Musoja akazova mutsvene (1491–1556), akavamba Sangano raJesu akanyora Zvidzidzo zveMweya, zvose "nokuda kokubwinya kukuru kwaMwari."
Charles Borromeo: Arkibhishopi weMilan (1538–1584) akavandudza Chechi mushure meKanzuru yeTrent akachengeta varwere panguva yedenda.
Elizabeth Ann Seton: Mukadzi, amai, chirikadzi uye akatendeuka (1774–1821), akavamba Masista eRudo nezvikoro zveKaturike muAmerica. Mutsvene wekutanga akaberekerwa muUnited States.
Isidore the Laborer: Mushandi wepurazi kuMadrid (akafa 1130), akatendeka kuMisa yezuva nezuva uye ane rupo kuvarombo. Muchengeti wevarimi.
Saint Lucy: Mhandara uye mufiri weSyracuse (akafa 304), zita rake rinoreva kuti "chiedza." Muchengeti wemapofu.
Saint Cecilia: Mhandara uye mufiri weRoma aiimbira Mwari mumwoyo make. Muchengeti wevaimbi nemimhanzi tsvene.
Clare of Assisi: Muteveri waMutsvene Francis (1194–1253) uye muvambi weVaClare Varombo, akazvipira kuurombo nekuSakaramende Rakaropafadzwa.
Pope John Paul II: Papa kubva 1978 kusvika 2005, akazvarwa Karol Wojtyła muPoland, mufambi asinganeti akaudza nyika kuti "musatya." Akaitwa mutsvene muna 2014.
Pope Pius X: Papa kubva 1903 kusvika 1914 akakurudzira kugamuchira Chirairo kazhinji akachibvumira kuvana vaduku, "kuvandudza zvinhu zvose muna Kristu."
Luke the Evangelist: Chiremba uye shamwari yaMutsvene Pauro, akanyora Evhangeri yaRuka neMabasa avaApostora. Muchengeti wanachiremba nevanodhirowa.
Mark the Evangelist: Shamwari yaMutsvene Petro uye munyori weEvhangeri yaMako. Muchengeti weVenice.
Matthew the Apostle: Muteresi akadaidzwa naJesu kuti ave Muapostora, akanyora Evhangeri yokutanga.
Bartholomew the Apostle: Mumwe wegumi navaviri, akanzi naIshe "muIsraeri chaiye asina hunyengeri," akaparidza Evhangeri akafa semufiri.
Helena, mother of Constantine I: Mambokadzi uye amai vaConstantine Mukuru, akawana Muchinjikwa wechokwadi parwendo rwake rutsvene kuJerusarema.
Brigid of Kildare: Mukuru wemasista kuKildare (akafa munenge 525), aidiwa nokuda kwetsitsi dzake nokugamuchira vaeni. Muchengeti weIreland.
Louis IX of France: Mambo weFrance (1214–1270), mutongi akarurama akazvipira kuminamato nekuvarombo.
